_comment: Product-signal taxonomy for AFH. `non_actionable` is checked BEFORE themes and short-circuits — reserve it for intake that can never carry signal. `non_actionable_fallback` is checked only AFTER every theme has missed, so a soft noise rule can never swallow a real defect. Themes are matched in order, first match wins. All regexes are case-insensitive (re.I|re.M) and applied to summary + body + labels. Themes may carry `subthemes`: a second pass, first-match-wins, over the same haystack. Anything a theme matches but no sub-theme does is reported as 'Other', which is the honest bucket -- never pad the sub-themes to make it disappear.
